info.title: Mindwire daemon API
info.description: One protocol over every coding-agent harness. The daemon hosts every registered adapter; a request selects one with `?agent=<type>` (falling back to the default). All endpoints, including `GET /healthz`, require the daemon bearer token. Workspace registry metadata is shared across harnesses. Turns/runs/chats are shared (keyed by chatId); auth, config, and creds are isolated per agent type.

bearer.description: Set DAEMON_TOKEN on the daemon (required). Authorized runtime/SSH clients can recover it from the private daemon.token file beside STATE_PATH.

agent.name: agent
agent.description: Agent type to target (e.g. `claude-code`). Falls back to the daemon default.

dir.name: dir
dir.description: Project directory for project-scope memory/prompt operations. Defaults to the daemon's own working directory.

scope.name: scope
scope.description: Which single-template scope to target. Defaults to `user`.

name.name: name
name.description: Prompt template name (bare, without a `.md` suffix or path separators).

operationId.description: Stable ID for this confirmed deletion; reuse it after a lost acknowledgement.

expectedRevision.description: The project record revision confirmed by the user.

workspaceMetadataVersion.description: Absent on daemons predating the workspace registry.

projectOperationsVersion.description: Durable project-operation protocol version; absent on older daemons.

surfaceProtocolVersion.description: 1 when the shared desktop protocol is available.

notificationPreferencesVersion.description: 1 when workspace-owned profile/chat notification mutes are enforced; absent on older daemons.

harnessPolicyVersion.description: 1 when exact approved harness versions are selected by the daemon; absent on older binaries.

gitAccessVersion.description: 1 supports workspace/project GitHub bindings and Git credential forwarding.

gitOperationsVersion.description: Durable Git operation protocol: 1 for worktree/network operations, 2 adds branch operations, 3 adds repository-scoped commit author setup and machine-readable identity errors.

serviceUpdateVersion.description: 1 supports atomic idle admission before service replacement.

workspaceIsolationVersion.description: 1 supports container placement as the outer sandbox boundary without changing approval policy.

workspaceIsolation.description: Placement selected by the trusted service launcher.

gitIdentityVersion.description: Independent Git author settings; version 1 supports repository, workspace and client-distributed all-workspaces defaults.

workspaceExecutionVersion.description: Protocol capability version; zero means unavailable.

terminalProtocolVersion.description: Protocol capability version; zero means unavailable.

computerConnectionVersion.description: Protocol capability version; zero means unavailable.

numCpu.description: Logical CPU cores visible to the daemon.

numGoroutine.description: Live goroutines — a rough concurrency gauge.

memAllocBytes.description: Heap objects currently in use (runtime HeapAlloc), bytes.

memSysBytes.description: Total memory reserved from the OS (runtime Sys), bytes.

ProcessSample.description: One running turn's live resource use at a single sampling tick. Labels and numbers only — never a secret. A turn runs in its own process group; the figures are summed over that whole group (bash → node → the agent).

agent.description: Agent type this turn belongs to.

chatId.description: Chat/session the turn is running for.

runId.description: Run id of the turn (the sampling key).

pid.description: Group-leader pid — the whole turn's process tree.

cpuPercent.description: CPU% over the last sampling window (delta of cumulative CPU seconds ÷ wall-clock). 0 on the first tick a group is seen.

rssBytes.description: Resident set size (physical memory) summed over the process group, bytes.

ProcessFrame.description: One sampling tick of the on-demand resource stream: every currently-tracked turn that had a live process this tick. An empty samples array (no running turns) is a valid keep-alive frame.

cwd.description: Project dir the turn runs in (optional override).

mode.description: Run shape. Absent or "turn" (default) = one ordinary turn that ends at the CLI's terminal result. "resolve" = a global-resolve run: the daemon holds the run open and auto-continues the agent's own multi-step work until the task is globally complete, returning a parent Run whose per-iteration turns are its children (GET /runs/{id}/children).

resolve.description: Optional bounds for a resolve-mode run (ignored unless mode is "resolve").

gitAuth.description: Fresh authorization for this turn or for a completed message question that starts another turn. Never placed in the transcript.

ResolveOptions.description: Optional per-request bounds on a global-resolve run. A zero/absent field falls back to the daemon default (max iterations / overall deadline).

maxIterations.description: Cap on auto-continued iterations before the run ends with stopReason "capped". 0/absent = daemon default.

deadlineSeconds.description: Overall wall-clock budget for the whole resolve, in seconds. 0/absent = daemon default.

TurnOptions.description: Per-turn parameters distinct from the agent's sticky settings. All optional.

settings.description: Per-turn setting overrides addressed by canonical key (see Field.canon). Resolved canon→the selected agent's key and filtered to declared non-secret keys server-side; overrides win over the sticky config.

systemPrompt.description: Fully REPLACES the agent's default system prompt for this turn (distinct from the sticky appendSystemPrompt).

sessionId.description: Pin an explicit session id for this turn.

continueLatest.description: Resume the most recent session in the cwd.

forkOnResume.description: Branch a new session id from the resumed one instead of continuing it in place.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema constraining structured output. Materialized to a per-turn temp file (e.g. Claude's --json-schema); cleaned up when the turn ends.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers configuration object (the shape the agent's --mcp-config file expects). Materialized to a per-turn temp file; not persisted.

subagents.description: Per-turn subagent definitions in the agent's native shape (Claude's --agents inline JSON: {name:{description,prompt}}). Gated by the subagents capability. Not persisted.

claudeSettings.description: Per-turn settings/hooks bundle in the agent's native format (Claude's --settings, where hooks/permissions/env live). Materialized to a per-turn temp file; gated by the claudeSettings capability. Not persisted.

attachments.description: Files made available to the turn, referenced from the message text.

Attachment.description: A file made available to a turn (path-reference only). Set path for a file already on disk (preferred), or data (base64) for inline bytes the daemon writes to a temp file, then references.

name.description: Display/file name shown to the agent when referenced.

path.description: Absolute path to a file already on disk (preferred).

data.description: Inline bytes, base64-encoded (Go []byte); written to a temp file, then referenced.

Run.description: A single turn's lifecycle record (the stream carries its events). A global-resolve run is a PARENT (kind="resolve") whose auto-continued iterations are child runs carrying parentId; an ordinary turn leaves all resolve fields absent.

kind.description: Absent for an ordinary turn; "resolve" marks the parent of a global-resolve run (its children stream onto its topic).

parentId.description: Set on a child iteration of a resolve run: the id of its parent resolve Run. Absent on ordinary turns and on the parent itself.

stopReason.description: Parent-only: why the resolve loop ended — "done" (the agent signalled completion), "capped" (hit the iteration/deadline bound), "error", or "cancelled".

iterations.description: Parent-only: how many child turns the resolve loop ran.

action.description: Deep-normalized view of the tool call (canonical kind + structured payload). Optional; rides alongside the raw name/input/output.

subtype.description: The agent's own terminal-result classifier when it distinguishes one (Claude's result subtype: "success", "error_max_turns", "error_max_budget_usd", …). Absent for agents whose terminal event is always fully settled (Codex).

incomplete.description: Derived convenience: true when the turn stopped short on a continuable subtype (max turns / max budget) rather than genuinely finishing. The signal a global-resolve run auto-resumes on.

cancelled.description: The harness stopped at the user request. No error notification is sent.

ContinuationInfo.description: Delimits one iteration of a global-resolve run on the merged parent stream. The daemon emits a continuation event before each child turn (and once at the caps boundary), so a client reading the parent topic can tell one sub-turn from the next and see WHY the loop advanced.

reason.description: Why this iteration is running: "start" (first), "max_turns"/"max_budget" (resuming a continuable stop), or "probe" (a clean settle with no completion sentinel — probing for done).

childRunId.description: The child Run this iteration streams under (its own record in the tree).

stopReason.description: Set only on the FINAL boundary: why the loop ended.

CompactionInfo.description: Normalized record of a conversation compaction (auto or on-demand). Rides on a compaction event and on a Part of type=compaction so a client can show when and how a conversation's context was condensed.

trigger.description: What caused the compaction, when the agent reports it: "auto" (context threshold reached) or "manual" (on-demand). Absent when the agent doesn't say.

preTokens.description: Context token count before compaction; absent when the agent doesn't report it.

postTokens.description: Context token count after compaction; absent when the agent doesn't report it.

summary.description: The compaction summary text, when the agent records one.

Event.description: One normalized event in a run's stream (same shape for every agent).

delta.description: true = incremental text delta; false/absent = final.

tokens.description: Cumulative token count for the block (e.g. thinking preview).

compaction.description: Present for type=compaction: the normalized compaction record.

continuation.description: Present for type=continuation: the resolve-mode iteration boundary.

itemId.description: Stable item identity for text and thinking snapshots.

sequence.description: Monotonic event sequence within a run. Reconnect using the after query parameter to receive unseen events only. Connection sentinels have no sequence.

replay.description: True for events replayed from the run buffer; absent or false for newly arriving activity.

action.description: Deep-normalized view of the tool call (canonical kind + structured payload). Optional; rides alongside the raw name/input/output.

ToolKind.description: Canonical, agent-independent classification of a tool call.

ToolAction.description: Normalized view of a tool call. Only the sub-object matching `kind` is populated; the rest are absent. Rides alongside the untouched raw input/output so a client can render the diff / command / changes without knowing any one agent's private tool vocabulary.

title.description: Short human label (e.g. the command or the path).

FileChange.description: One file touched by a file_edit action.

diff.description: Best-effort unified diff; absent when the agent doesn't supply enough to compute one (e.g. Codex's live file_change reports path+op only). Empty means "not supplied", never "no change".

oldText.description: Best-effort; absent when the agent doesn't supply it.

newText.description: Best-effort; absent when the agent doesn't supply it.

ShellCommand.description: A shell action. stdout is the combined/aggregated output as the agent gave it.

stderr.description: Best-effort; absent when the agent doesn't report it (Claude's Bash merges stderr into stdout). Absent means "not reported", never an empty stderr.

exitCode.description: Best-effort; absent when the agent doesn't report it (Claude's Bash surfaces no exit code). Absent means "not reported", never exit 0.

WebSearch.description: A web search (query) or a URL fetch (url); the parent action's kind disambiguates.

compaction.description: Present for type=compaction: the normalized compaction record on a system message marking where the conversation was condensed.

RenameRequest.description: Rename a chat. An empty/omitted title clears any user rename, reverting to the native/derived title.

ForkRequest.description: Fork a chat. newChatId is optional — a random id is generated when omitted.

CompactRequest.description: On-demand compaction. instructions is optional — when present it focuses the continuation summary (Claude's `/compact <instructions>`); agents that don't honor focus still compact.

DeleteResult.description: Result of a chat delete: the bookkeeping was purged, plus which agents' native transcripts were removed vs. failed to remove.

sessions.description: How many (agent, session) mappings the chat had.

nativePurged.description: Agent types whose native transcript was removed.

nativeFailed.description: Agent types whose native delete errored.

imageInput.description: Client hint: image attachments are delivered as true vision content (the model sees the image), not just a path it must open with a Read tool. Attachments themselves are ungated.

memory.description: Agent exposes persistent memory files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) via /memory.

promptTemplates.description: Agent exposes saved prompt templates (slash-commands / saved prompts) via /prompts.

subagentDefs.description: Agent exposes persistent subagent definition files (.claude/agents/*.md) via /subagents. Distinct from the per-turn `subagents` passthrough.

mcpConfig.description: Agent exposes persistent MCP-server config via /mcp (Claude .claude.json / .mcp.json, Codex config.toml). Distinct from the per-turn `mcpServers` passthrough.

compactNow.description: Agent supports on-demand conversation compaction via POST /chats/{id}/compact. The authoritative gate is the CompactModule type assertion in the daemon; an adapter that implements it sets this true.

resolve.description: Agent supports global-resolve runs (POST /turns {mode:"resolve"}). Unlike the other switches this is NOT gated in the daemon — resolve is pure daemon logic over the existing resume path, so every agent that can resume can be resolved; the flag is a UI hint only.

ModelInfo.description: A model reported by the installed harness or explicitly configured provider. Native reasoning levels and defaults are optional; unknown metadata stays absent.

id.description: Model id passed as the `model` setting.

toolCall.description: Whether the model supports tool calls.

custom.description: True when the model comes from a registered custom provider (see /providers) rather than the built-in catalog.

reasoningEfforts.description: Reasoning levels reported by the installed harness for this exact model.

ModelCost.description: Per-million-token pricing for a model, from the on-disk catalog. Every field is optional.

MemoryScope.description: Canonical location of a persistent artifact: `project` (inside a working directory) or `user` (the agent's config home).

MemoryDoc.description: One persistent memory file (Claude CLAUDE.md / Codex AGENTS.md) at a canonical scope.

path.description: Resolved absolute path — always set, even when the file is absent.

exists.description: Whether the file exists (distinguishes empty from missing).

PromptTemplate.description: A saved, reusable prompt (Claude slash-command / Codex saved prompt).

content.description: Omitted in list results; populated on a single read.

SubagentMeta.description: Best-effort parsed view of a subagent definition's frontmatter. A convenience only — the raw `content` is canonical. Every field is optional; absent frontmatter yields no meta object.

Subagent.description: One persistent subagent definition file (Claude .claude/agents/<name>.md). `content` is the canonical raw body (omitted in list results, populated on a single read/write); `meta` is the parsed convenience view (absent when the file has no usable frontmatter).

name.description: Definition identity: its frontmatter `name`, else the filename stem.

content.description: Raw file body. Omitted in list results; populated on a single read.

MCPServer.description: One persistent MCP-server definition, the canonical agent-agnostic shape. Two forms: stdio (command/args/env/cwd) and streamable-HTTP (url/bearerTokenEnvVar/httpHeaders). SECURITY: bearerTokenEnvVar is the NAME of an env var holding a token, never a secret value; mindwire never injects its own credentials here.

env.description: stdio: environment for the server process.

cwd.description: stdio: working directory for the server process.

bearerTokenEnvVar.description: HTTP: NAME of the env var holding the bearer token (never the value).

httpHeaders.description: HTTP: static headers sent with each request.

defaultToolsApprovalMode.description: Codex native approval behavior for this MCP server.

CustomProvider.description: One registered custom OpenAI-compatible LLM provider. SECURITY: the API key is NEVER part of this shape — it is supplied write-only on PUT and reported only as `hasKey`. The harness config references the key solely through an env-var placeholder; the value lives in the daemon and enters a run only via the auth env path.

id.description: Provider id (config key). Letters, digits, `-`, `_`; must start with a letter or digit.

name.description: Human label; falls back to the id.

models.description: Model ids offered by this endpoint.

envVar.description: NAME of the env var the key is exported/referenced as. Derived from the id when omitted.

hasKey.description: Whether a secret is stored for this provider (never echoes the key itself).

CustomProviderWriteRequest.description: PUT body for registering a custom provider: the CustomProvider fields plus a write-only `apiKey`. An omitted/empty apiKey leaves any previously stored key intact (metadata-only update). The key is stored in the daemon and never returned.

envVar.description: Optional explicit env-var name; derived from the id when omitted.

apiKey.description: Write-only secret. Stored in the daemon, referenced in harness config only via an env-var placeholder, never returned by any GET.

RespondRequest.description: Answer one pending interaction. Complete every required question atomically. Native controls expire with their run. A responseMode=message question remains answerable using its runId: the daemon steers a running turn or resumes the conversation. Repeating the same accepted message answer is idempotent. Unknown actions or incomplete forms return 400; stale, conflicting or concurrent replies return 409.

interactionId.description: The interaction being answered (from the Interaction event).

decision.description: An exact ID from the interaction options, preserving native approval scope.

options.description: Selected option(s) for a multi-select question.

text.description: Free-form answer text, or the deny reason.

answers.description: Answers keyed by native question ID, including selections and feedback.

gitAuth.description: Fresh authorization for this turn or for a completed message question that starts another turn. Never placed in the transcript.

InputRequest.description: A follow-up message steered into a running turn.

SetModelRequest.description: Switch the model of a live turn. An empty/omitted model resets the turn to the agent/CLI default.

SetPermissionModeRequest.description: Switch the permission mode of a live turn (required).

help.description: Contextual help shown when this option is selected.

Action.description: A user action surfaced with an interaction or notification (e.g. Approve / Reject).

TodoItem.description: One entry of a todos interaction.

Interaction.description: A structured, self-describing request the agent surfaces mid-turn for the client to render generically — and, when needsResponse, for the user to answer.

kind.description: todos, approval, choice, select, input, form, plan, warning, info, error; clients should retain unknown kinds.

responseMode.description: A native async question answered as a user message. Omitted for native control requests.

runId.description: Daemon run to address when answering this interaction, including from history.

response.description: The accepted answer, persisted by the daemon.

blocking.description: Whether a pending request blocks the turn. Defaults to true when omitted.

feedback.description: When an approval accepts feedback. Omitted when unsupported.

FieldCondition.description: Show and submit a field only when the referenced field has this value, after resolving defaults.

scope.description: unified = a cross-agent concept addressed by canon; custom = agent-specific.

canon.description: Stable cross-agent key; equals key for custom fields.

requiredUnless.description: A required field may be left blank when any named alternative field has a value.

advanced.description: Optional or alternative inputs that auth forms may initially collapse.

presentation.description: Native select presentation: segmented or menu. Unknown hints use the client's default control.

inputMode.description: Text keyboard hint, such as url.

minimum.description: Inclusive lower bound for numeric text.

maximum.description: Inclusive upper bound for numeric text.

AuthSection.description: Daemon-owned grouping, order, and context for an authentication form.

AuthMethod.description: One way to authenticate an agent. Field-based methods collect `fields`; interactive ones drive a begin→step→status flow.

scope.description: unified = a cross-agent auth concept (API key, login, gateway token); custom = agent-specific (e.g. Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry), declared + typed, never open passthrough. Empty reads as unified.

fields.description: Inputs to collect for a field-based method (reuses the settings Field shape).

AuthState.description: The current step of an in-progress auth flow.

flowId.description: Interactive attempt ID. Echo as _flowId in step inputs, polls, and cancellation.

fields.description: Inputs the client should collect next.

AuthStatus.description: The resting state: is the agent authenticated, and via which method.

signedOut.description: Explicit workspace sign-out; remains until a new connection completes.

operation.description: The shared job operation, including jobs started by another client.

stage.description: Live phase of the current step. Completion is reported only after its check passes.

plan.description: Ordered tool names in this job. Successful steps indicate step progress, not a download percentage.

startedAt.description: The shared job's start time, preserved across client reconnects.

format.description: webhook sends raw Notification JSON; push sends title/body with string-valued data for a push relay.

hasToken.description: Whether a bearer token is stored; the token itself is never returned.

NotifyChannelMasked.description: The read-side view of a notification channel. Secrets are never returned — the URL, token, HMAC secret, and header values are all withheld; only their presence (and the URL host, as a display hint) is reported.

urlHost.description: Host portion of the destination URL (display hint only; the full URL is never returned).

hasUrl.description: Whether a destination URL is stored.

headerKeys.description: Names of extra request headers (values withheld).

hasToken.description: Whether a bearer token is stored.

hasSecret.description: Whether an HMAC signing secret is stored (webhook type only).

NotifyChannelInput.description: The write-side body for creating or updating a channel. On PUT, every field is optional and merges onto the stored channel: an omitted or blank `url`/`token`/`secret` preserves the stored value (so a round-trip of the masked read view can't wipe secrets), while `headers` is replaced only when present (send `{}` to clear).

type.description: Outgoing payload shape. Defaults to `webhook` (raw Notification JSON) on create.

url.description: Destination URL. Required (on create). For slack/discord this is the incoming-webhook URL; for telegram the full bot `sendMessage` URL. Write-only — never returned.

headers.description: Extra request headers sent with each delivery. Values are secret (write-only).

token.description: Bearer token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Write-only.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing key (webhook type only). When set, each delivery carries `X-Mindwire-Signature: sha256=<hex>` over the raw body. Write-only.

NotifyChannelTestResult.description: Outcome of a synthetic delivery to one channel. The send result is DATA — a failed delivery still returns HTTP 200 with `ok:false` and an `error` message.

NotifyRule.description: A routing rule. On every emitted notification the daemon evaluates all enabled rules, unions the channels of those that match (by scope + condition), and delivers to each. Rules carry no secrets.

id.description: Server-assigned rule id. Omit on create.

scope.description: `global` matches every notification; `agent` matches when the emitting adapter type equals `agent`; `session` matches when the chatId equals `session`.

agent.description: Required when scope is `agent`: the adapter type to match (e.g. `claude-code`).

session.description: Required when scope is `session`: the chatId to match.

conditions.description: Notification conditions this rule fires on. Empty means all conditions.

channelIds.description: Ids of the channels to deliver to when this rule matches.

Question.description: One question in a native form. Selection uses option IDs; text can accompany selected options as feedback.

workspaceId.description: Registry identity, independent of the hosting provider ID.

notificationsMuted.description: Mutes this saved profile and all its current and future chats, independent of other profiles using the same harness. Omit to preserve an existing value; send false to clear. Applies to every notification channel and condition. Requires notificationPreferencesVersion >= 1.

Mutes this saved profile and all its current and future chats, independent of other profiles using the same harness. Omit to preserve an existing value; send false to clear. Applies to every notification channel and condition. Requires notificationPreferencesVersion >= 1.

workspaceId.description: Registry identity, independent of the hosting provider ID.

gitConnection.description: Omit to inherit the workspace default on creation. On metadata edits omission preserves the binding; explicit null restores inheritance.
Omit to inherit the workspace default on creation. On metadata edits omission preserves the binding; explicit null restores inheritance.

workspaceId.description: Registry identity, independent of the hosting provider ID.

notificationsMuted.description: Mutes this chat; false clears its own mute but does not override a muted parent profile. Omit to preserve an existing value; send false to clear. Applies to every notification channel and condition. Requires notificationPreferencesVersion >= 1.

Mutes this chat; false clears its own mute but does not override a muted parent profile. Omit to preserve an existing value; send false to clear. Applies to every notification channel and condition. Requires notificationPreferencesVersion >= 1.

full.description: Replace this workspace cache when true; otherwise apply rows and tombstones as a delta.

connectionId.description: The selected connection ID. Rejects an account change between reading project state and starting an operation.

ProjectCloneAuth.description: Write-only Git credentials, separate from messages and settings. Run credentials expire with the operation or agent run. Only explicit workspace lifetime stores them. Oblien grants are read-only and cannot be saved for future runs.

path.description: Absolute path or ~/...; resolved on the workspace.

repoUrl.description: Credential-free repository URL, only for clone.

gitConnection.description: Omit to inherit the workspace default on creation. On metadata edits omission preserves the binding; explicit null restores inheritance.

path.description: Absolute path or ~/...; resolved on the workspace.

repoUrl.description: Credential-free repository URL, only for clone.

projectId.description: Created project ID, or the target project ID for removal.

expectedRevision.description: Confirmed project revision for a file-removal operation.

gitConnection.description: Omit to inherit the workspace default on creation. On metadata edits omission preserves the binding; explicit null restores inheritance.

data.description: Base64 PNG bytes, at most 8 MiB decoded. Private authenticated resource; not a provider URL.

kind.description: pointer, click, drag, scroll, key, text, clipboard_read, clipboard_write, release

textMode.description: Optional physical US keyboard input for text actions, preserving the clipboard. Requires keyboardText capability; printable ASCII only, at most 4096 bytes.

SurfaceBinding.description: Write-only workspace-scoped authorization. Never include an owner session JWT. Provider passwords are stored only in the existing private credential store.

SurfaceReceipt.description: A dispatched receipt acknowledges sending input to VNC, not an application outcome. Observe the desktop to verify. An outcome_unknown action must not be repeated blindly. Request IDs are retained for at least 24 hours.

version.description: Exact approved version; npm tags and ranges are not accepted.

latestVersion.description: Latest approved catalog entry, which may require a newer daemon; not npm latest.

compatibility.description: supported, untested, incompatible, or not_installed. Unknown versions are untested, never implicitly approved for installation.

missingDependencies.description: Missing shared tools. Run setup to repair them even when the CLI is already installed.

GitConnection.description: Non-secret account reference. A missing project binding inherits the workspace default. Native uses existing server Git configuration. Workspace lifetime explicitly permits storing a credential on this server.

activeOperations.description: Active fetch/pull/push requests. Daemon updates must wait until zero.

storedConnections.description: Saved account references without secrets, available to another device.

repoUrl.description: The actual origin resolved by Git, including URL rewrites, with embedded credentials removed.

id.description: Stable client request ID. Reuse the same ID and intent after a lost acknowledgement.

paths.description: Literal paths relative to the repository root. Required for stage/unstage/discard; absolute paths, traversal, and .git internals are rejected.

message.description: Required only for commit. Uses the existing server Git author identity.

auth.description: Network operations only; held in memory for this operation and never included in its receipt.

branch.description: Literal branch name for switch_branch/create_branch. Requires gitOperationsVersion >= 2. Creation switches to the new branch without resetting existing refs or discarding local work.

remote.description: switch_branch only: branch is a remote tracking name such as origin/feature. Creates a local tracking branch from the existing remote ref without fetching.

identity.description: Commit only. Requires gitOperationsVersion >= 3. Author setup and commit share one durable operation; retain the same identity on retries.

id.description: Stable client request ID. Reuse the same ID and intent after a lost acknowledgement.

paths.description: Literal paths relative to the repository root. Required for stage/unstage/discard; absolute paths, traversal, and .git internals are rejected.

message.description: Required only for commit. Uses the existing server Git author identity.

path.description: Canonical repository root resolved by the daemon.

branch.description: Literal branch name for switch_branch/create_branch. Requires gitOperationsVersion >= 2. Creation switches to the new branch without resetting existing refs or discarding local work.

remote.description: switch_branch only: branch is a remote tracking name such as origin/feature. Creates a local tracking branch from the existing remote ref without fetching.

identity.description: Commit only. Requires gitOperationsVersion >= 3. Author setup and commit share one durable operation; retain the same identity on retries.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable failure. git_identity_required means the commit has not run and the client should ask for author name/email. Submit a new commit intent with identity after user confirmation.

pid.description: The idle daemon process; stop only this PID.

GitIdentity.description: Explicit commit attribution, saved to repository-local Git configuration. Never modifies global configuration.

defaultRevision.description: Opaque revision used for an acknowledged shared-default delivery.

GitIdentityUpdate.description: Saves attribution only. Null removes this override. all_workspaces requires requestId and expectedRevision, and updates only this daemon; clients distribute their default to each connected workspace. Never stages or commits.

data.description: Raw terminal bytes. Retry exactly this writer/sequence/data after a lost acknowledgement.

post.description: Explicit filesystem deletion, separate from metadata-only DELETE /workspace/projects/{id}. The daemon checks the project revision, running chats and overlapping projects, reserves the directory, and moves it into an owned quarantine. Membership tombstones commit atomically with the deleting phase. Recovery then cleans only the quarantine, preserving a new directory at the original path. Native harness transcripts are retained. Disconnecting never cancels work; cancellation is rejected after the deleting boundary.

get.description: The daemon PROCESS's own runtime stats (heap in use, memory reserved from the OS, goroutines, GC cycles) plus host facts (cores, platform, uptime). Cheap and on-demand — a single runtime.ReadMemStats, no background sampling. Not the whole machine's RAM/CPU.

Server-Sent Events of live resource use for currently-running turns, grouped by agent. On-demand and refcounted: the daemon starts sampling only while at least one client is connected and stops the instant the last one disconnects — zero background work when nothing is watching. Each turn runs in its own process group; a sample is the whole group's summed RSS and its CPU% over the sampling window. Same `data: <json>\n\n` framing and `: ping` heartbeat as the run stream; one ProcessFrame per frame. Optional `?agent=` filters each frame's samples to one agent. Payload carries labels and numbers only — no secrets.

post.description: Starts one detached, shared job for the harness. Concurrent setup/update requests join it. Poll GET /setup for live steps and verification. Supplied identity is saved only in this repository. Persists the intent before executing native Git. The same ID and intent returns the existing operation, even after completion or restart; a different intent with that ID returns 409. Network writes use the selected project connection. Local mutations need no GitHub credential. Disconnecting only detaches the observer. Active Git, project, and agent work in overlapping directories conflicts. After a daemon restart, unfinished operations become interrupted and are never replayed automatically. Operations are bounded to 15 minutes.
